input_contract.ground_truth: raw eight-column VisDrone CSV; class/category remains publisher 0..11
input_contract.predictions: eight-column VisDrone CSV or records with bbox_xywh, score, category 0..11, unique detection_id; no implicit conversion from YOLO class_id
input_contract.target_identity: image_id plus zero-based original physical annotation line, including blank-line positions
input_contract.prediction_identity: explicit unique ID; original input row order is retained for deterministic ties
input_contract.positive_GT_nonpositive_geometry: REFUSE; affected training components must be quarantined before evaluation

official_source_region_prefilter.region_definition: category=0 GT only, regardless of score; category=11 and score=0 alone are not global raster regions
official_source_region_prefilter.raster: union of category-0 regions; max(1,xywh); inclusive one-based x:x+w,y:y+h, upper image edges clipped
official_source_region_prefilter.region_coordinate_requirement: integer source region xywh; noninteger regions explicitly refused
official_source_region_prefilter.query: MATLAB half-away-from-zero round then max(1,xywh); x/y clipped to image; integral query covers (x,x+w] and (y,y+h]
official_source_region_prefilter.denominator: rounded, lower-clamped original w*h, not clipped area
official_source_region_prefilter.drop_condition: raster_fraction >= 0.5 for both non-category0 GT and detections
official_source_region_prefilter.returned_coordinates: original raw boxes survive unchanged; mask query is not a returned-box clip

project_primary_target_metric.name: PROJECT_IGNORE_AWARE_TARGET_MATCHING
project_primary_target_metric.effective_GT: after category-0 filter, score=1 and category 1..10, nonempty box after clip
project_primary_target_metric.box_policy: category-0 prefilter on raw boxes first; clip surviving target/prediction xyxy to [0,W]x[0,H]
project_primary_target_metric.matching: same-category, one-to-one global greedy descending (IoU, confidence, original GT physical line, original detection input index)
project_primary_target_metric.score0_absorption: only unmatched considered predictions; same class score=0 GT; intersection/prediction area >= primary IoU threshold; an ignored GT can absorb multiple predictions
project_primary_target_metric.others: category 11 is outside evaluated classes; others GT does not absorb predictions of classes 1..10
project_primary_target_metric.truncation_and_occlusion: retained as attributes; no exclusion based on either
project_primary_target_metric.NMS: not implemented here; upstream candidate filtering, NMS and max_det must be separately frozen
project_primary_target_metric.FP_precision_recall_scope: project confidence/ignore/matching policy; never labeled official VisDrone AP
project_primary_target_metric.empty_denominator: must be reported N/A or insufficient evidence by downstream analysis, never automatic PASS

official_style_single_image_metric.name: UNCERTIFIED_OFFICIAL_STYLE_SINGLE_IMAGE_MATCHING
official_style_single_image_metric.cap_order: category0 prefilter then first max_detections across all classes in submitted input order, before class extraction and score sorting
official_style_single_image_metric.matching: per-class confidence-descending, valid-GT preferred; continuous raw-coordinate IoU, ignore-GT uses intersection/prediction area
official_style_single_image_metric.ties: Python stable detection input order; equal overlap replaces with later GT; MATLAB version tie behavior remains unverified

official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.interpolation: VOC monotonic precision-envelope integral at recall changes; not COCO 101-point sampling
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.class_averaging: literal calcAccuracy evalClass appends category once per image containing that category, without unique; class repetition affects final averaging
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.recall_denominator: literal calcAccuracy numel(gtMatch) includes surviving same-class score=0 GT flags
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.class_availability: source checks any surviving GT of class, including ignored GT
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.submission_order: must be frozen explicitly; source does not globally sort submitted detections before per-image cap
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.NMS: none in fixed official evaluation path
official_AP_source_semantics_not_yet_imp.required_before_official_equivalence_cla: run official MATLAB/Octave oracle on pinned synthetic fixtures covering all edge cases and validate full aggregation, ordering and denominators

training_monitor_boundary.builtin_YOLO_mAP50_95: train-derived training_val monitoring and checkpoint selection only; no official AP or Gate1 mechanism claim
training_monitor_boundary.ignored_region_negative_loss: ordinary YOLO labels omit ignored positives but ordinary loss does not mask ignored-area negative examples; limitation persists
training_monitor_boundary.checkpoint_selection: must not use Selection or Holdout; freeze exact criterion/tie rule and resulting weight SHA separately

technical_validation.installation_search_scope_limit: these checked locations only; not proof that no installation exists elsewhere

remaining_before_full_Gate1_acceptance: freeze research contract, actual prediction/NMS adapter, candidate order and metric family
validate official AP via a pinned official runtime oracle or keep that acceptance item explicitly incomplete
verify actual data true-scene and near-duplicate independence; synthetic tests do not prove data independence
validate model numeric/precision contracts and data-role access separately
run no Holdout until selection and analysis contracts are frozen
